rationale: The plan correctly identifies the paired structure and blocks on subject with ~subject + condition in DESeq2, cross-checked with edgeR QL on the same design, so the tested coefficient is a genuine within-subject contrast. QC precedes the model with blind VST, PCA labelled by subject and coloured by condition, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes, plus an explicit within- vs between-subject distance summary and a stated no-drop policy justified by the cost of losing a pair. Filtering is minimal and justified (>=10 counts in >=5 samples, the smallest group size) followed by independent filtering; normalization is median-of-ratios/TMM estimated inside the models with an explicit ban on pre-scaling; reference level is set by relevel and the contrast is named with numerator and denominator; BH at alpha 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, lfcThreshold inside results() rather than post hoc, and separate accounting of Cook's-flag versus independent-filter NAs. Enrichment, though not strictly demanded by the question, is executed correctly on the full ranked list by Wald statistic with a stated universe, named and versioned collections, 15-500 size window, collapsePathways, seed, and a sensible gate against ORA on short lists; the report section names versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant counts, and includes per-subject paired panels that expose fragile single-pair calls. Minor deductions only for the filter and enrichment being slightly heavier than the question requires.
